message.reasoning_content:
The claim: "The growth mindset intervention increased overall enrolment in advanced mathematics courses."

Passage [1] states: "improved grades among lower-achieving students and increased overall enrolment to advanced mathematics courses in a nationally representative sample of students in secondary education in the United States."

This directly states the claim: increased overall enrolment to advanced mathematics courses. Same direction, same outcome. So verdict: supported, passage 1.
